segments.sn7.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena paccanīkasāto nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati.
segments.sn7.16:1.5: Yaṃ yadeva samaṇo gotamo bhāsissati taṃ tadevassāhaṃ [tadeva sāhaṃ (ka.)] paccanīkāssan”ti [paccanīkassanti (pī.), paccanīkasātanti (ka.)].
segments.sn7.16:1.6: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā abbhokāse caṅkamati.
segments.sn7.16:1.7: Atha kho paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.16:3.3: Āghātaṃ paṭinissajja, sa ve [sace (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] jaññā subhāsitan”ti.
segments.sn7.16:4.1: Evaṃ vutte, paccanīkasāto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.16:4.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe “sabbaṃ setan”ti vutte “sabbaṃ kaṇhan”tiādinā nayena paccanīkaṃ karontassevassa sātaṃ sukhaṃ hotīti paccanīkasāto.
Yo ca vineyya sārambhanti yo karaṇuttariyalakkhaṇaṃ sārambhaṃ vinetvā suṇātīti attho.
“Sabbaṃ setan”ti kenaci vutte tassa paccanīkaṃ karontasseva assa brāhmaṇassa.
Suṇātīti atthoti “suṇātī”ti kiriyāpadaṃ āharitvā gāthāya attho veditabbo “jaññā subhāsitan”ti vuttattā.
Na hi asutvā desitaṃ jānituṃ sakkonti.
